blocks.en_text: Hi Georgie. How are you?
blocks.zh_text: 嗨，Georgie。你好吗？

blocks.en_text: I'm pretty good thank you, Phil.
blocks.zh_text: 我挺好的，谢谢你，Phil。

blocks.en_text: How are you doing?
blocks.zh_text: 你怎么样？

blocks.en_text: I'm really good.
blocks.zh_text: 我非常好。

blocks.en_text: I think you're going to be even better when you find out
blocks.zh_text: 我觉得等你知道了

blocks.en_text: what we're talking about today.
blocks.zh_text: 我们今天要聊什么，你会更开心的。

blocks.en_text: Tell me.
blocks.zh_text: 告诉我吧。

blocks.en_text: Well, I know we often talk about food, but today we're talking about desserts.
blocks.zh_text: 嗯，我知道我们经常聊食物，但今天我们聊的是甜点。

blocks.en_text: You were right.
blocks.zh_text: 你说对了。

blocks.en_text: I love desserts or puddings – sometimes we call them puddings in the UK.
blocks.zh_text: 我超爱甜点，或者说布丁——在英国我们有时候管它们叫布丁。

blocks.en_text: I have a big sweet tooth so, yeah, I will love this.
blocks.zh_text: 我特别爱吃甜的，所以，对，我肯定会喜欢这个。

blocks.en_text: I will love talking about this topic.
blocks.zh_text: 我会很乐意聊这个话题。

blocks.en_text: Fantastic. Let's get started.
blocks.zh_text: 太好了。那我们开始吧。

blocks.en_text: Well, first, before we start talking about my favourite topic,
blocks.zh_text: 好，首先，在我们开始聊我最喜欢的话题之前，

blocks.en_text: we have to remind our listeners that they can find a free worksheet
blocks.zh_text: 我们得提醒一下听众，他们可以找到一份免费的学习单

blocks.en_text: and transcript to help them learn at bbclearningenglish.com.
blocks.zh_text: 和文字稿来帮助学习，就在 bbclearningenglish.com。

blocks.en_text: So, Georgie, I think this is a silly question
blocks.zh_text: 那么，Georgie，我觉得这个问题有点傻，

blocks.en_text: and I think I know the answer already,
blocks.zh_text: 而且我觉得我已经知道答案了，

blocks.en_text: but do you like desserts?
blocks.zh_text: 不过，你喜欢甜点吗？

blocks.en_text: Ah... do I like desserts?
blocks.zh_text: 啊……我喜欢甜点吗？

blocks.en_text: I love desserts!
blocks.zh_text: 我超爱甜点！

blocks.en_text: I have a really big sweet tooth, which means that I really like sweet things,
blocks.zh_text: 我特别爱吃甜的，意思是我真的很喜欢甜的东西，

blocks.en_text: sugary things – I put sugar in my coffee sometimes.
blocks.zh_text: 含糖的东西——我有时候会在咖啡里加糖。

blocks.en_text: But I... if I'm in a restaurant, I will always order a dessert.
blocks.zh_text: 但是我……如果我在餐厅，我一定会点一份甜点。

blocks.en_text: I would prefer to have a dessert or pudding than a starter, actually.
blocks.zh_text: 其实比起前菜，我更愿意要一份甜点或布丁。

blocks.en_text: Yeah. What about you? Do you like them?
blocks.zh_text: 是啊。你呢？你喜欢吗？

blocks.en_text: Yeah, I do. I think...
blocks.zh_text: 嗯，我喜欢。我觉得……

blocks.en_text: I think in a restaurant I'd probably order a starter rather than a dessert.
blocks.zh_text: 我觉得在餐厅我可能更会点前菜，而不是甜点。

blocks.en_text: But yeah, it's nice when you get a good one.
blocks.zh_text: 不过，能吃到一份好的甜点还是很棒的。

blocks.en_text: Ah, it's so good.
blocks.zh_text: 啊，太好吃了。

blocks.en_text: I quite like homemade desserts – so, I don't know... homemade apple crumble.
blocks.zh_text: 我挺喜欢自制的甜点——比如，我想想……自制苹果酥。

blocks.en_text: Ooh, that's really good.
blocks.zh_text: 哦，那个真的很好吃。

blocks.en_text: So, that's when we cook the apples a little bit so they're quite soft,
blocks.zh_text: 就是把苹果稍微煮一下，让它们变得很软，

blocks.en_text: and then we put a biscuit topping at the top.
blocks.zh_text: 然后在上面铺一层饼干碎。

blocks.en_text: And it's really, really delicious.
blocks.zh_text: 真的非常非常美味。

blocks.en_text: And it's a hot... a hot dessert.
blocks.zh_text: 而且它是一道热……热的甜点。

blocks.en_text: Yeah. And a lot of fruit puddings that I quite like – they're sweet but
blocks.zh_text: 对。还有很多我很喜欢的水果布丁——它们很甜，但

blocks.en_text: they're also a bit sharp as well.
blocks.zh_text: 同时也带点酸味。

blocks.en_text: A bit sweet, a bit sour.
blocks.zh_text: 有点甜，有点酸。

blocks.en_text: That's a really nice combination. I love that.
blocks.zh_text: 这个搭配真的很好。我很喜欢。

blocks.en_text: Well, I do love fruit puddings but I am a chocolate person,
blocks.zh_text: 嗯，我确实很喜欢水果布丁，但我是个巧克力控，

blocks.en_text: so if I have a menu in a restaurant, I will always look for the chocolate
blocks.zh_text: 所以如果我在餐厅拿到菜单，我一定会找巧克力

blocks.en_text: dessert – maybe a chocolate brownie, chocolate cake, ice cream as well.
blocks.zh_text: 甜点——也许是巧克力布朗尼、巧克力蛋糕，还有冰淇淋。

blocks.en_text: That's a really good dessert.
blocks.zh_text: 那真是很棒的甜点。

blocks.en_text: And sometimes if you're feeling very full after the meal,
blocks.zh_text: 有时候如果你吃完饭觉得很饱，

blocks.en_text: ice cream is a good option because it doesn't feel too filling, does it?
blocks.zh_text: 冰淇淋是个不错的选择，因为它不会让人觉得太撑，对吧？

blocks.en_text: Do you like ice cream?
blocks.zh_text: 你喜欢冰淇淋吗？

blocks.en_text: Yes, I really love ice cream.
blocks.zh_text: 喜欢，我特别爱吃冰淇淋。

blocks.en_text: I like most flavours of ice cream, I think.
blocks.zh_text: 我觉得大部分口味的冰淇淋我都喜欢。

blocks.en_text: I like the creamy ones and then some of the fruity ones as well,
blocks.zh_text: 我喜欢奶油味的，然后也喜欢一些水果味的，

blocks.en_text: like mango ice cream or something.
blocks.zh_text: 比如芒果冰淇淋之类的。

blocks.en_text: On a hot day you can't beat it.
blocks.zh_text: 大热天吃这个真是没得比。

blocks.en_text: Do you often eat dessert?
blocks.zh_text: 你经常吃甜点吗？

blocks.en_text: No, I don't think I do.
blocks.zh_text: 不，我觉得我不常吃。

blocks.en_text: Not that often. I keep it as a treat for, like,
blocks.zh_text: 没那么经常。我把它当作一种犒赏，比如

blocks.en_text: a special occasion or something to make a meal feel really special –
blocks.zh_text: 特殊场合，或者让一顿饭显得特别特别的东西——

blocks.en_text: dessert with it. But yeah, I wouldn't...
blocks.zh_text: 配上一道甜点。不过对，我不会……

blocks.en_text: I wouldn't have it every week, I don't think.
blocks.zh_text: 我觉得我不会每周都吃。

blocks.en_text: No, because it's not very healthy to eat too much sugar, is it?
blocks.zh_text: 不会，因为吃太多糖不太健康，对吧？

blocks.en_text: You're very good.
blocks.zh_text: 你真棒。

blocks.en_text: I do eat pudding and dessert quite a lot.
blocks.zh_text: 我确实经常吃布丁和甜点。

blocks.en_text: I... Yeah, I just get really strong sugar cravings after meals.
blocks.zh_text: 我……对，我饭后就是会特别想吃甜食。

blocks.en_text: What's the best dessert you've ever had?
blocks.zh_text: 你吃过的最好吃的甜点是什么？

blocks.en_text: OK. Well, I said that my favourite puddings are chocolatey,
blocks.zh_text: 好。嗯，我说过我最喜欢的布丁是巧克力味的，

blocks.en_text: but actually I think the best dessert I've ever tried,
blocks.zh_text: 但其实我觉得我尝过的最好吃的甜点，

blocks.en_text: because it was the first time, was when I was in Jordan
blocks.zh_text: 因为那是第一次，是我在约旦的时候

blocks.en_text: and I tried something called knafeh, and this is like a...
blocks.zh_text: 我尝了一种叫knafeh的东西，这就像一种……

blocks.en_text: it's actually a cheesy pudding so it has cheese in it,
blocks.zh_text: 它其实是一种奶酪布丁，所以里面有奶酪，

blocks.en_text: but it then has a kind of crispy topping that I think is made of honey
blocks.zh_text: 但上面有一层酥脆的配料，我觉得是用蜂蜜做的

blocks.en_text: or sugary syrup, so it has the kind of savoury, which means salty,
blocks.zh_text: 或者糖浆，所以它有那种咸香，也就是咸味，

blocks.en_text: of the cheese – the salty flavour of the cheese – plus the sugary bit at the top.
blocks.zh_text: 奶酪的——奶酪的咸味——再加上上面甜甜的部分。

blocks.en_text: And it was so delicious.
blocks.zh_text: 而且它太好吃了。

blocks.en_text: I ate all of it and it's, yeah, very rich.
blocks.zh_text: 我全吃光了，而且，对，非常浓郁。

blocks.en_text: That sounds amazing.
blocks.zh_text: 听起来太棒了。

blocks.en_text: Do you have a favourite one?
blocks.zh_text: 你有最喜欢的一道吗？

blocks.en_text: The one I can remember best – I had it in a restaurant
blocks.zh_text: 我记得最清楚的一道——我是在一家餐厅吃的

blocks.en_text: in Argentina about 20 years ago, and I can still remember it.
blocks.zh_text: 大约20年前在阿根廷，我现在还记得。

blocks.en_text: And it was deep-fried ice cream, which sounds crazy.
blocks.zh_text: 那是油炸冰淇淋，听起来很疯狂。

blocks.en_text: It's like ice cream and it was fried in, like, sweet batter or pastry.
blocks.zh_text: 它就像冰淇淋，然后裹着甜甜的面糊或酥皮炸过。

blocks.en_text: It was amazing. And I can remember it 20 years later.
blocks.zh_text: 太惊艳了。20年后我还记得。

blocks.en_text: That sounds incredible.
blocks.zh_text: 听起来太不可思议了。

blocks.en_text: That's something that's very common in Scotland actually.
blocks.zh_text: 其实这在苏格兰很常见。

blocks.en_text: I'm surprised you had it in Argentina.
blocks.zh_text: 你居然在阿根廷吃到，我很惊讶。

blocks.en_text: Maybe not ice cream,
blocks.zh_text: 也许不是冰淇淋，

blocks.en_text: but in Scotland they like to deep fry – so, put something in a lot of oil.
blocks.zh_text: 但在苏格兰，他们喜欢油炸——就是把东西放进很多油里炸。

blocks.en_text: They do that with chocolate bars and things like that so,
blocks.zh_text: 他们连巧克力棒之类的东西都这么炸，所以，

blocks.en_text: yeah, not very healthy.
blocks.zh_text: 是啊，不太健康。

blocks.en_text: No, not at all...
blocks.zh_text: 对，一点也不健康……

blocks.en_text: but lovely.
blocks.zh_text: 但很好吃。

blocks.en_text: So delicious!
blocks.zh_text: 太好吃了！

blocks.en_text: OK. So, let's recap the vocabulary that we've been looking at today.
blocks.zh_text: 好。那我们来回顾一下今天学过的词汇。

blocks.en_text: We're talking about desserts.
blocks.zh_text: 我们说的是甜点。

blocks.en_text: We also, particularly in the UK, call them 'puddings'.
blocks.zh_text: 尤其是在英国，我们也把它们叫作“puddings”（布丁）。

blocks.en_text: And that's just something sweet that you eat at the end of a meal.
blocks.zh_text: 也就是你在一餐饭最后吃的甜的东西。

blocks.en_text: Yes. If you really like puddings and desserts and sweet things,
blocks.zh_text: 对。如果你真的很喜欢布丁、甜点和甜食，

blocks.en_text: you could be described as 'having a sweet tooth'.
blocks.zh_text: 就可以说你“爱吃甜食”（having a sweet tooth）。

blocks.en_text: I have a sweet tooth, for example.
blocks.zh_text: 比如说，我就爱吃甜食。

blocks.en_text: Yes. Of course, puddings aren't just sweet.
blocks.zh_text: 对。当然，布丁不只是甜的。

blocks.en_text: I talked about apple crumble, a very traditional British pudding,
blocks.zh_text: 我提到了苹果酥，一种非常传统的英国布丁，

blocks.en_text: and it's a little bit 'sharp', which kind of means the same as sour.
blocks.zh_text: 它有点“sharp”（酸），意思差不多就是sour（酸）。

blocks.en_text: So, like, a lemon pudding would be sharp or sour.
blocks.zh_text: 所以，比如柠檬布丁就会是sharp或者sour的。

blocks.en_text: We also heard the word 'filling', which describes a food
blocks.zh_text: 我们还听到了“filling”这个词，它形容一种食物

blocks.en_text: or a pudding which makes you feel full.
blocks.zh_text: 或者布丁，吃了会让你觉得很饱。

blocks.en_text: Oh, and Georgie, you said you were a 'chocolate person'.
blocks.zh_text: 哦，还有Georgie，你说过你是个“chocolate person”（巧克力爱好者）。

blocks.en_text: What do you mean by that?
blocks.zh_text: 你这话是什么意思？

blocks.en_text: That just means that I am a person who really likes chocolate.
blocks.zh_text: 意思就是我是个特别喜欢吃巧克力的人。

blocks.en_text: What kind of person are you, Phil?
blocks.zh_text: Phil，你是什么样的人呢？

blocks.en_text: I think I might be an ice cream person.
blocks.zh_text: 我想我可能是个冰淇淋爱好者。

blocks.en_text: I'm also an ice cream person.
blocks.zh_text: 我也是个冰淇淋爱好者。

blocks.en_text: I'm also a chocolate person.
blocks.zh_text: 我也是个巧克力爱好者。

blocks.en_text: Well, Phil. That is the end of this episode of Real Easy English.
blocks.zh_text: 好了，Phil。这期Real Easy English就到这里结束了。

blocks.en_text: We will of course be back next week with another conversation.
blocks.zh_text: 我们下周当然会带着另一段对话回来。

blocks.en_text: Yes, we will.
blocks.zh_text: 是的，我们会回来的。

blocks.en_text: And don't forget that we have a worksheet
blocks.zh_text: 别忘了我们还有一份练习表

blocks.en_text: that you can get from our website.
blocks.zh_text: 你可以在我们的网站上下载。

blocks.en_text: And that's bbclearningenglish.com.
blocks.zh_text: 网址是bbclearningenglish.com。

blocks.en_text: Goodbye.
blocks.zh_text: 再见。
